title: Choosing a replacement inner tube
titleZh: 挑選替換用的自行車內胎
passage:
THE WHEELHOUSE BULLETIN
What to bring when you buy an inner tube

Start by checking the side of your current tyre. On a label such as 32–622, the first number is the tyre width and the second is the diameter at the point where the tyre sits on the rim. Both are in millimetres. The same tyre may carry other numbers, including an air pressure. If you find the label hard to read, photograph the whole side of the tyre so the shop can identify the right pair of numbers.

An inner tube box often shows a range of tyre widths. A box marked 28–35 mm is suitable for either a 28 mm or a 35 mm tyre of the stated diameter, and for widths in between. The width range does not make the tube suitable for a different diameter. Check the diameter first, then look for a range that includes your tyre width.

The valve is a separate choice. If the new tube's valve is thicker than the old one, it may not fit through the hole in the wheel rim. If you are unsure which kind you have, take a picture of the valve before you take the old tube out. The shop can identify it without asking you to bring in the whole bicycle.

車輪工坊通訊
購買內胎時要帶哪些資訊

先看看目前這條外胎的側面。以 32–622 這種標記為例，前面是外胎寬度，後面是外胎胎唇在輪圈上就位處的直徑。兩個數字的單位都是毫米。同一條外胎也可能標示其他數字，例如胎壓。如果標記不易辨認，可以把外胎整個側面拍下來，讓店家找出正確的一對數字。

內胎盒上常標示適用的外胎寬度範圍。例如標示 28–35 毫米的盒子，表示在盒上指定的直徑下，內胎可搭配寬度為 28 毫米、35 毫米或兩者之間的外胎。外胎寬度符合範圍，並不表示這個內胎可用於不同直徑。請先確認直徑，再找寬度範圍涵蓋自己外胎的款式。

還需要另外確認氣嘴。如果新內胎的氣嘴比舊的粗，可能穿不過輪圈上的孔。如果你不確定使用的是哪種氣嘴，拆下舊內胎前先拍一張氣嘴的照片。店家可以根據照片辨認，不用把整台自行車帶過去。
